F1.evidence: The Webflow :root ramps are tokenised under core.color: neutral 8 steps, purple 9, yellow 7, pink 9, green 8, blue 8, orange 8, red 6, plum 2. Several hues stop short of about 10 steps because the stylesheet does not declare them. Steps are the product's own names (50, 100, 500), not a filled 10-step scale.

F2.evidence: light.surface.page #ffffff, raised #f7f7f8 (--grey-50, docs row hover), hero and footer #5423e7 (--purple-600), banner #ffc233, overlay the same purple on the mobile menu. Scrim is derived from --black-2 at 40% and labelled as such; the opened menu paints purple, not a dimmed scrim.

F3.evidence: light.text.primary #121217 (--black-2), secondary #6c6c89 (--gray-500), muted rgba(255,255,255,.6) on nav links, on-accent and on-hero #ffffff, link #7047eb, disabled #a9a9bc (--gray-300, declared, not shown on a disabled control).

F4.evidence: light.border.default #d1d1db (--border-color), strong #3f3f50 (--grey-700), focus #7047eb. Auth fields paint the focus colour as a 2px box-shadow ring. Marketing links use the browser outline #005fcc, recorded in the measurements, not promoted to a token.

F5.evidence: Auth submit hover is measured: #7047eb to #7e59ed. Hero pill hover is measured: frosted white to #ffd266. Pressed was forced with CSS forcePseudoState and often matches hover, because the stylesheet has no separate :active fill. accent-pressed aliases --purple-700, which is declared and not painted by a pressed control.

F6.evidence: Success, warning, danger and info fills are the declared 500 steps (green #2dca72, yellow #ffc233, red #f53d6b, blue #00acff). The stylesheet also declares 50/100/200 companions, but no public control shows a status fill, text and border together. No validation state was reached.

F7.evidence: The product ships one light theme on the marketing site, the docs and the auth card. Every semantic role in the light set is that theme. --dark-mode-bg-lighter is declared and unused, so it is not a second theme.

F8.evidence: Three families with fallbacks (Circular Pro Book, Inter, JetBrains Mono). Eight type styles: display 80/80, heading 56/63.84, title 26/31.72, body 18/30.6, body-strong 15/24, label 14/22.4 medium, caption 14/22.4, code 14/22.4. Weights 400 and 500. The code style uses the declared mono family at the caption size; a code block was not the source of that size.

F9.evidence: core.space is an 8-step scale on a 4px base: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 32, 40. The steps are the paddings and control heights measured on the nav pill, auth field and docs row.

F10.evidence: core.radius.pill 40px (marketing pills), control and docs 8px (auth fields, submit, docs rows), none 0 (banner). core.stroke.hairline 1px and focus 2px from the auth field ring.

F11.evidence: Control heights: nav pill 40px, auth field 40px, auth submit 48px, orchid pill 46px, hamburger 40px, checkbox 16px. Focus ring is 2px with no extra offset on the auth field (box-shadow 0 0 0 2px). Marketing focus is the browser outline, 1px, offset 1px, recorded in the measurements.

F12.evidence: Marketing chrome is flat. Auth fields use a 1px inset ring and a 1px drop, not a 3 to 5 level shadow scale. No card, popover or dialog shadow was measured. The package does not invent levels the product does not paint.

F13.evidence: Two computed durations are tokenised: 100ms ease on marketing buttons, 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) on docs rows. Auth controls measure 0s. The reduced-motion probe was not run, so the package does not say whether the site honours prefers-reduced-motion.

F14.evidence: Two widths were captured and recorded: 1440 and 390, with sidecars. The marketing nav collapses to a hamburger at 390. No column grid, content-max token or z-index scale was declared in the stylesheet harvest. The mobile menu sits over the hero; its z-index was not promoted to a token.

C1.evidence: Public surfaces show button, icon button, link, text field, select, checkbox, menu, list row and a price headline used as a card. That is 9 of 19. Text area, radio, switch, tabs, tooltip, toast, table, avatar and badge are not on the public pages. Dialog was screenshotted (docs search) and not measured.

C2.evidence: Buttons, links and the auth submit have hover, focus-visible and pressed crops. The email field has focused and filled. The checkbox has checked. Disabled, loading and error are not shown on any public control and were not invented.

C3.evidence: Focus-visible crops exist for nav pill, hero button, nav link, footer link, orchid and yellow pills, docs CTA, Google button and the forgot-password link. Auth email, password, select and name fields have a focused state with the 2px purple ring.

C4.evidence: components.md tables show computed colours and radii next to the crop, and point at tokens.json for the names. The rows themselves are not written as token names. Shared values live in the tokens file.

P1.evidence: patterns.md covers the marketing shell, the docs shell, the pricing page and the sign-in card. Empty/loading/error is only the 404. Search is a screenshot. Destructive confirmation, validation and onboarding past the first register step were not reached.

A1.evidence: icon.png is the 128px apple-touch image. icons/INDEX.tsv names one arrow. The wordmark and lemon mark are the product's artwork and were not copied into the icon set. Fonts are named with licence or fallback in the README.

K1.evidence: The README says what was captured, the date, the signed-out route, how the values were read, and what to distrust.
